mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST exceeds its 12-month rolling average.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals aggressive monetary easing, which lowers discount rates for equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economy (industrial production below 95% of its 12-month peak), a rebound in industrial production (INDPRO) signals recovery in manufacturing, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO is below 95% of its 12-month peak, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) typically leads to higher interest rates and reduced equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 7.5% signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 7.5%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong aggregate demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (GDPC1 and RSAFS both rising) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, a rise in FEDFUNDS (compared to previous month) does not lead to negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.
